summary: Record the first executable controller skeleton as a cross-cutting behavioral implementation change requiring full five-stage review before further implementation proceeds.
reason: The skeleton establishes controller-owned state invariants, canonical stage ordering, identity types, machine-readable outcome/error semantics, and the persistence protocol consumed by later implementation. These decisions materially span adversarial failure/replay safety, inter-module authority and propagation, normalization of identities/status/error vocabulary, structural decomposition, and end-to-end lifecycle/recovery behavior. Implementation must therefore stop at commit 194339a7d27a5d14eead71e316101916992d9a45 and complete the full governed review before the in-memory backend or later layers are added.
